findings.label: Basic-active override of other languages
findings.issue: With Basic's set active (Basic is the primary metamodel, or a Basic context is chosen), step 2 gives every other loaded language's elements and relationships Basic's generic look and flattens ArchiMate's relationship notation. For example, am4:Composition becomes NoDecoration→OpenArrowhead. This follows the brief's order (step 2 before step 3).
findings.action: User decision: accept, or change the order in the spec. Pin the relationship case with a test either way.

findings.label: Basic elements missing from the palette next to another language
findings.issue: taxonomy.ts:326-327 synthesises a flat axis only when the store has no axis at all. The real basic-tax.ttl is the only flat published taxonomy, so it contributes no palette entries once ArchiMate 4.0 is loaded. Basic's relationships and its canvas styling are unaffected. The root cause predates this change, and the test fixture hides it with an axis wrapper.
findings.action: Give basic-tax.ttl an axis concept, as every other taxonomy has, or synthesise a flat axis per scheme in la-gram. Then reshape basic-fixture.ts to match the real files.

findings.label: Palette-only sizing and Graph look
findings.issue: sizeOf (mount-ui.ts:978) and graphLook (mount-ui.ts:885) ignore notationIndex. Classes the palette does not list get 120×55 boxes in new views, and no colour or line style in the Graph tab.
findings.action: Read both through NotationStyleRegistry or notationIndex.
